name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 closed near 10,481 on 23 Nov, 3.9% below its 52-week high; no daily fall above 2.5% this week
state: The FTSE 100 closed near 10,481 on 23 Nov, about 3.9% below its 52-week high of roughly 10,911 and inside the 5% Normal line (Yahoo Finance). Its worst day in the last five sessions was -1.3%, inside the 2.5% line, and the index is about 2% lower on the week and 2.7% lower on the month. The measured drawdown keeps the level at Normal.
for_you: UK pensions and funds that track the FTSE 100 are close to recent highs. Large UK companies earn much of their income abroad, so the index is sensitive to global markets and the pound.
why: The UK's main index — a gauge of UK-listed multinationals, pensions and sterling-area sentiment.
drivers: Commodity prices, sterling, global risk appetite, UK policy and banking sector news.
